_readme: Maps doc ROLES to actual paths in THIS project. api/api-standard intentionally unmapped (the v4 contract is the parity harness + generated swagger, no handwritten API spec file); declined rather than guessed.

api.declined: No handwritten API spec maintained; the v4 contract is the parity harness + generated swagger (config/cors-l5-swagger at build).

api-standard.declined: No separate API-standard doc; convention is enforced by the parity harness and DTO validation.

brief.declined: No design-brief artefacts — scope lives in docs/DESIGN.md + upstream roadmap.

builds.declined: No tracked build matrix doc; CI definition lives in .github/workflows/ci.yml (runner-gated).

common-mistakes.declined: Not maintained; PHPStan/Pint/baseline enforce the rules instead.

contributing.declined: Contribution workflow is upstream (jikan-me/jikan-rest); fork is PR-#614 only.

deprecations.declined: No formal deprecation ledger; changes are documented in docs/PR_CHANGELOG.md.

documentation-rules.declined: No formal doc-rules doc; docs stay lightweight and this manifest is the map.

postmortem.declined: No incidents recorded; postmortem file created if/when one happens.

public-roadmap.declined: No public roadmap maintained; scope is docs/DESIGN.md + UPSTREAM_PR.md.

release.declined: No release process here; upstream owns releases, this fork ships via PR series.
